front: Name four contemporary methods of preserving food.
Why should mouldy groundnuts or grain be thrown away?
back: Some moulds produce poisons (aflatoxins) that cause serious illness; washing does not remove them.

front: Why do small grains matter for food security?
back: They tolerate drought better than maize and store well.

front: Give four food hygiene rules for storage.
back: Wash hands; use clean, dry, sealed containers; dry food fully; keep raw meat away from cooked food (also check dates, do not refreeze).
